channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Aug 18
item.description:
115 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Melee weapons now correctly damage foundations that include staircases when hitting from the soft side.
  • Darts UI zoom control removed and the leaderboard (including score cards) now updates reliably after server restarts, with streamer‑mode compatibility.
  • Wind turbine sound stops playing when the turbine isn’t spinning.
  • Binocular glare effect is fixed and works again.
  • Desk monument blockers now render properly, and larger blockers have reduced health; battering‑ram visuals are correctly reset in containers.

NPC & AI

  • Fixed scientists not spawning in Underwater Labs, Cargo Ships, and Military Bases, and cargo scientists now move correctly.
  • Old scientists now turn instantly; Scientist2 on Oilrig no longer crouch‑walk at odd angles.
  • Navmesh fixes prevent NPCs from getting stuck during tile rebuilds and ensure AI spawned before a navmesh is built can locate it.

World & Monuments

  • Foundations with staircases now take melee damage correctly (soft‑side LOS fixed).
  • Monument blockers’ health reduced, bonus resource rates disabled, and melee time‑to‑kill values standardized; desks blocker now renders.
  • Static chairs on the gas‑station roof are mountable again.

Vehicles & Equipment

  • Vehicle pooling bugs resolved: catapult ammo persists, siege weapons reset properly, wheel collider warnings removed, helicopter rotor speed resets on init, and horse spawning issues fixed.
  • Honey bandage now reliably applies its healing effect.
  • Binocular glare behavior corrected and wind turbine sound stops when not spinning.

Gameplay & Content

  • Darts leaderboard UI fixed with streamer‑mode support and proper persistence after server restarts.
  • New livestock species added: cows and sheep with male/female variants; animals no longer move while sleeping and sheep now have a sleeping animation.
  • Animal fencing revamped: fence gates tweaked, hold‑to‑place removed, and an alternate implementation tested.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Aug 17
item.description:
48 development commits

Animals

  • Fixed the gender bug: livestock now spawn with the correct male/female distribution instead of all being female.
  • Added a breeding state machine, enabling animals to breed as intended.
  • Introduced a Bull prefab, so bulls now appear in the world.

Server & UI

  • Nexus connect modal now correctly enables the map button and no longer squishes the map view.
  • Nexus map UI issues resolved, preventing the map from being distorted after recent changes.
  • Server listings now hide zone servers by default and expose Nexus info in A2S rules responses.
  • MaxPlayers count displayed correctly after recent adjustments.
  • General Nexus connect modal fixes improve stability when joining servers.

Items & Equipment

  • Medical honey bandage effects now fire properly, restoring the intended healing behavior.
  • Water bucket UI bug fixed: players can now transfer water into a held bucket without errors.

Vehicles

  • Resolved a pooling issue where runtime‑parented vehicle children caused null‑reference errors, improving vehicle spawn stability.
